llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed mkts.io market-data integration with consent-gated account changes and no hidden local execution.

dimensions.detail: Network calls to mkts.io and optional API-key use are necessary for the stated function, with instructions to keep the key private and minimize submitted private content.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a single markdown skill requiring curl with optional MKTS_API_KEY; no executable scripts, package installs, or hidden install-time actions were present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions default to read-only use, require exact payload display and explicit confirmation for POST/PATCH/DELETE operations, and warn against following external-content instructions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Portfolio, journal, watchlist, registration, and card outputs can create persistent external records or files, but the skill discloses this and requires user-directed confirmation and no documented local persistence beyond user-requested image output.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill covers market data plus portfolio, journal, and watchlist workflows; account mutations and private financial data handling are purpose-aligned and clearly described.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, understand that financial interests, notes, watchlists, and an optional email registration can be sent to mkts.io and stored there. Use an environment variable for the API key, review every displayed payload before confirming any account change, and avoid putting secrets or unnecessary personal details into notes or natural-language queries.
